checks.name: Stock word
checks.why: It could sit on any product's page. Say what this one does.

checks.name: Gradient across hues
checks.why: A two-hue gradient is the first thing generated pages reach for. A solid colour holds the brand better.

checks.name: Coloured glow
checks.why: A glow lifts it with no light to explain it. A soft neutral shadow or a border does the job.
